title: Panorra API Go New Project Report

issues.main_description_html:
RESULT 26/08/26

✅ Implementation: Consolidate Legacy Slug Generation

Changes

  • Added Functions.GenerateLegacySlug beside the existing random and filename helpers in Functions.go.
  • The helper preserves the existing algorithm:
    • Shuffle the lowercase alphabet and take one character.
    • Generate five random bytes and encode them as ten lowercase hexadecimal characters.
    • Append a hyphen and time.Now().Format("2006010215040500").
    • Keep the existing ignored random-byte error behavior for strict compatibility.
  • Replaced four duplicated blocks:
    • Posts/AddPost.
    • Posts/AddPostGothru.
    • Posts/InitAddPost.
    • Bookmarks/CreateFolderBookmarks.
  • Removed time imports only from files where they became unused.
  • Left GenerateUniqueSlug unchanged because it generates a longer format and returns errors.
  • Left PickOfTheDay unchanged because its slug includes an ec-prefixed random string.
  • Kept worker, cronjob, and API collection files outside scope.

Tests

  • Added a focused helper test covering:
    • Exact 28-character length.
    • One lowercase-letter prefix.
    • Ten lowercase hexadecimal characters.
    • A five-byte decodable hexadecimal segment.
    • A 16-character timestamp with the legacy literal 00 suffix.
  • Verified the test first failed with undefined: GenerateLegacySlug, then passed after implementation.

Verification

go test ./src/Utils/Functions -run TestGenerateLegacySlugPreservesFormat -count=1
go test ./src/Action/V1/Posts ./src/Action/V1/Bookmarks ./src/Utils/Functions -count=1
go test ./... -count=1
go vet ./src/Action/V1/Posts ./src/Action/V1/Bookmarks ./src/Utils/Functions
git diff --name-only -- src/Worker src/Action/V1/Cronjob
git diff --check

Results:

  • Focused helper and affected-package tests pass.
  • Full repository tests pass.
  • Focused go vet passes.
  • All four scoped blocks use the shared helper.
  • GenerateUniqueSlug and Pick of the Day remain unchanged.
  • No worker or cronjob file changed.
  • Diff whitespace validation passes; only Git line-ending warnings are reported.
  • Independent review reports no findings.

Problem

Four post and bookmark flows repeat the same legacy slug-generation block. Keeping the algorithm in each handler risks inconsistent slug formats and duplicate maintenance.

Scope

  • Add a shared Functions.GenerateLegacySlug helper.
  • Replace four identical blocks in Posts and Bookmarks actions.
  • Preserve the exact legacy format: one lowercase letter, ten lowercase hexadecimal characters, a hyphen, and a 16-character timestamp ending in the literal 00.
  • Preserve the existing runtime time.Now() behavior and ignored RandomBytes error semantics.
  • Keep GenerateUniqueSlug unchanged because its format and error contract differ.
  • Keep PickOfTheDay unchanged because it uses a different broadcast slug format.
  • Do not change worker or cronjob code.

Acceptance Criteria

  • Generated legacy slugs match ^[a-z][0-9a-f]{10}-[0-9]{14}00$.
  • Generated legacy slugs contain exactly 28 characters.
  • The hexadecimal segment represents exactly five bytes.
  • All four matching blocks call Functions.GenerateLegacySlug.
  • GenerateUniqueSlug and the Pick of the Day slug flow remain unchanged.
  • Focused tests, go test ./..., and focused go vet succeed.
  • No worker or cronjob file changes.
  • git diff --check succeeds.

Delivery

  • Implemented locally on development.
  • Not committed or pushed.

issues.display_title: Issue #483: Consolidate Action JSON Base64 Encoding
issues.main_description_html:
Implementation: Consolidate Action JSON Base64 Encoding

Changes

  • Replaced three manual json.Marshal and base64.StdEncoding.EncodeToString blocks with Functions.EncodeBase64JSON.
  • Updated:
    • Notifications/PushNotification.go for the mention-post RabbitMQ payload.
    • Posts/EditPostDescription.go for the post-visibility update payload.
    • Posts/UpdatePostVideo.go for the post-visibility update payload.
  • Removed only Base64 imports that became unused. Kept JSON imports where other logic still needs them.
  • Reused the existing helper and base64_json_test.go; no duplicate helper or test was added.
  • Preserved payload data, queue names, publish behavior, logging, returned responses, and ignored encoding errors.
  • Left worker, cronjob, and API collection files unchanged.

Verification

go test ./src/Utils/Functions/... ./src/Action/V1/Notifications ./src/Action/V1/Posts
git diff --check -- src/Action/V1/Notifications/PushNotification.go src/Action/V1/Posts/EditPostDescription.go src/Action/V1/Posts/UpdatePostVideo.go
git diff --name-only -- src/Worker src/Action/V1/Cronjob

Results:

  • Functions, Notifications, and Posts package tests pass.
  • Scoped diff whitespace validation passes; Git reports only line-ending warnings.
  • Source diff contains three insertions and nine deletions across three action files.
  • No worker or cronjob file changed.
  • Existing API collection environment changes are unrelated user-owned changes and remain untouched.

Problem

Three action handlers manually marshal RabbitMQ payloads to JSON and encode the bytes with Standard Base64. The shared Functions.EncodeBase64JSON helper already provides the same behavior, so the repeated blocks add unnecessary maintenance and imports.

Scope

  • Replace the matching JSON marshal and Standard Base64 blocks in:
    • Notifications/PushNotification.go.
    • Posts/EditPostDescription.go.
    • Posts/UpdatePostVideo.go.
  • Reuse the existing Functions.EncodeBase64JSON helper and its tests.
  • Preserve RabbitMQ queue names, payload contents, publish order, publish-error handling, and ignored encoding-error behavior.
  • Remove imports made unused by the replacements.
  • Do not add a new helper or test for behavior already covered.
  • Do not change worker, cronjob, or API collection files.

Acceptance Criteria

  • All three scoped handlers call Functions.EncodeBase64JSON.
  • Their encoded RabbitMQ payloads remain byte-for-byte compatible with the previous json.Marshal plus base64.StdEncoding.EncodeToString flow.
  • Encoding errors remain ignored at these call sites, matching existing behavior.
  • Existing unrelated JSON marshaling remains unchanged.
  • Focused Functions, Notifications, and Posts package tests succeed.
  • No worker or cronjob file changes.
  • git diff --check succeeds for the scoped source files.

Delivery

  • Implemented locally.
  • Not committed or pushed.

issues.display_title: Issue #484: Consolidate Remaining JPEG Filename Generation
issues.main_description_html:
Implementation: Consolidate Remaining JPEG Filename Generation

Changes

  • Replaced three manual timestamp plus random-hex filename blocks with Functions.GenerateJPEGFilename.
  • Updated avatar upload V2, collection thumbnail upload, and profile avatar upload.
  • Removed the now-unused time import from collection thumbnail upload.
  • Reused the existing jpeg_filename_test.go; no duplicate helper or test was added.
  • Preserved HTTP errors, paths, file-save order, MinIO operations, signed image URLs, and response payloads.
  • Left RegisterGoogle unchanged because its filename timestamp comes from a shared now value.
  • Left slim responses, workers, notification-token handling, cronjobs, and API collection files unchanged.

Verification

go test ./src/Utils/Functions ./src/Action/V2/Users ./src/Action/V1/CollectionPost ./src/Action/V1/Users
rg -n 'RandomHex\(3\)|Format\("20060102150405"\)' src/Action/V2/Users/UploadAvatar.go src/Action/V1/CollectionPost/UploadThumbnailCollectionPost.go src/Action/V1/Users/EditProfile.go
git diff --check -- src/Action/V2/Users/UploadAvatar.go src/Action/V1/CollectionPost/UploadThumbnailCollectionPost.go src/Action/V1/Users/EditProfile.go

Results:

  • Focused package tests pass.
  • Search finds no remaining manual filename construction in the three scoped handlers.
  • Scoped whitespace validation passes; Git reports only line-ending warnings.
  • Source diff contains three insertions and nine deletions across three action files.
  • Excluded subsystems were not changed by this refactor.

Problem

Three image-upload handlers still build JPEG filenames manually from the current timestamp and three random bytes. The existing Functions.GenerateJPEGFilename helper already owns this exact format and error contract.

Scope

  • Replace manual timestamp, RandomHex(3), and fmt.Sprintf filename construction in:
    • Action/V2/Users/UploadAvatar.go.
    • Action/V1/CollectionPost/UploadThumbnailCollectionPost.go.
    • Action/V1/Users/EditProfile.go.
  • Reuse the existing helper and focused tests.
  • Preserve filename format, random-error responses, directory paths, upload order, MinIO behavior, signed URLs, and endpoint responses.
  • Remove imports made unused by the replacements.
  • Keep RegisterGoogle unchanged because it intentionally reuses an existing now value.
  • Do not change slim responses, workers, web-notification token handling, cronjobs, or API collection files.

Acceptance Criteria

  • All three scoped handlers call Functions.GenerateJPEGFilename.
  • Generated filenames retain the YYYYMMDDhhmmss.<six lowercase hex characters>.jpg format.
  • Existing random-generation error handling remains unchanged.
  • Focused Functions, V1 Users, V1 CollectionPost, and V2 Users package tests succeed.
  • No excluded subsystem changes.
  • git diff --check succeeds for scoped source files.

Delivery

  • Implemented locally.
  • Not committed or pushed.

Implementation: Consolidate RabbitMQ JSON Publishing

Changes

  • Added RabbitMQ.PublishJSON, which marshals a payload with json.Marshal and delegates the resulting string to the existing Publish function.
  • Added an internal injectable publisher seam used only to test serialization and error propagation without a live RabbitMQ server.
  • Migrated eight _send_email publishers across Auth, Register, Report, Supports, and Users.
  • Migrated moderation publishers for _banned_user, _banned_post, and _banned_comment.
  • Preserved queue construction, payloads, publish timing, caller-specific error logging, and endpoint responses.
  • Removed JSON imports only where no other JSON logic remains.
  • Left the original Publish and PublishMessage behavior unchanged.
  • Excluded slim responses, workers, cronjobs, notification-token handling, and API collection files.

Tests

  • Added focused tests covering:
    • Exact queue and JSON body passed to the publisher.
    • Marshal failure preventing publication.
    • Publisher error propagation.
  • Verified RED first: tests failed with undefined: publishJSON.
  • Verified GREEN after the minimal helper implementation.

Verification

go test ./src/Utils/RabbitMQ ./src/Action/V1/Auth ./src/Action/V1/Register ./src/Action/V1/Report ./src/Action/V1/Supports ./src/Action/V1/Users
git diff --check -- src/Utils/RabbitMQ src/Action/V1/Auth/Login.go src/Action/V1/Register/RegisterUser.go src/Action/V1/Report/ReportBug.go src/Action/V1/Supports/BannedUser.go src/Action/V1/Users/ContactUs.go src/Action/V1/Users/ForgotPassword.go src/Action/V1/Users/OtpDelete.go src/Action/V1/Users/ResendOtp.go

Results:

  • RabbitMQ and all five affected Action package groups pass.
  • All three new helper tests pass.
  • Scoped whitespace validation passes; Git reports only line-ending warnings.
  • No worker, cronjob, slim-response, or notification-token code changed.

Problem

Eight non-cronjob email flows and three moderation worker publishers manually marshal payloads to JSON before publishing them to RabbitMQ. The repeated serialization obscures the common wire contract and silently ignores marshal errors.

Scope

  • Add RabbitMQ.PublishJSON(queueName, payload) beside the existing publisher.
  • Make the helper marshal payloads with json.Marshal, then delegate to RabbitMQ.Publish unchanged.
  • Replace matching _send_email blocks in:
    • Auth/Login.go.
    • Register/RegisterUser.go.
    • Report/ReportBug.go.
    • Supports/BannedUser.go.
    • Users/ContactUs.go.
    • Users/ForgotPassword.go.
    • Users/OtpDelete.go.
    • Users/ResendOtp.go.
  • Replace matching moderation publishers in:
    • Supports/BannedUser.go for _banned_user.
    • Supports/BannedPost.go for _banned_post.
    • Supports/BannedComment.go for _banned_comment.
  • Preserve exact queue names, JSON wire bytes, publish-error logging, endpoint responses, and publish timing.
  • Remove imports made unused by migration.
  • Do not change slim responses, workers, cronjobs, web-notification tokens, or API collection files.

Acceptance Criteria

  • PublishJSON sends the provided queue name unchanged.
  • Payload output matches json.Marshal exactly.
  • Marshal errors prevent publishing and return the marshal error.
  • Publisher errors are returned unchanged.
  • All eleven scoped publishers use RabbitMQ.PublishJSON.
  • Focused RabbitMQ and affected Action package tests succeed.
  • git diff --check succeeds for scoped source files.

Delivery

  • Implemented locally.
  • Not committed or pushed.
